data.change_summary: Parameterized the remaining hardcoded shrimp molt knobs by adding named runtime/species fields for the molt-stress warning threshold, molt-stress mortality activation threshold, mineral-stress blend weights, pressure weights, rise/decay smoothing, high-GH penalty divisor, and mineral factor floor, then wired them through defaults, invariants, preset parsing/materialization, shipped shrimp data, and runtime usage in `update_molt_stress`, `compute_mortality_probabilities`, `emit_molt_stress_warning`, and `molt_mineral_modifier`. I also expanded regression coverage for the new tuning surfaces, and refactored the habitat geometry probes so summary runs use distinct artifact labels, the biofilter-scaling probe no longer gets a built-in nitrifier seeding advantage, and the light-depth probe keeps an explicit positive-growth guard while the biofilter assertions now check post-seeding terminal reduced-N plus biomass instead of a tautological cumulative-exposure win.
outstanding_risks: The worktree also contains unrelated concurrent edits in `crates/tank_core/tests/reproduction_factors.rs`, `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs`, `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7`, and the untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory; I left those as-is and did not reconcile or revert them.

steps.description: Added the remaining named molt-stress and mineral-penalty parameters to `ShrimpRuntimeParams`, invariant validation, preset/default plumbing, scenario materialization, and the shipped `neocaridina_davidi` species data.

Updated the shrimp runtime to consume the new parameters for stress accumulation, mortality activation, warning emission, and high-GH/Ca/Mg mineral penalties, then extended core/save-load/event regressions to prove the knobs are active and validated.

Refactored the habitat geometry probes to avoid summary-vs-standalone artifact collisions, removed the biofilter probe's capacity-scaled initial nitrifier advantage, and tightened the probe assertions around real post-seeding outcomes.
Ran formatting plus targeted and full-suite validation across `tank_core`, `tank_data`, `tank_scenarios`, and the habitat harness probes on the current tree.
